verses.1: And the word of Jehovah was spoken to me:
verses.2: And you, son of Adam, you have judged and condemned that city of bloodshed. You know all its evils.
verses.3: And you said, “Thus says Adonai YHWH: A city that pours blood within its streets. Now come and make destruction on it!”
verses.4: In your sins you have shed blood; in your wickedness, you have done evil deeds. For this reason, you will be brought before the nations as a source of shame and disgrace for all the earth.
verses.5: The distances and distances from you will be measured by you. The name of the great one is pure.
verses.6: Now, the leaders of Israel were each one of them. They were there so that blood could be shed.
verses.7: Father and mother, they have burdened you with their sins. They have done evil things within you, causing darkness and ignorance to reign in your midst.
verses.8: I have sanctified them and also my Sabbaths.
verses.9: The people of Rachil were among you. They ate meat and drank wine in your land. They also built houses within your land.
verses.10: The sin of your father has defiled you; the impurity of his actions has contaminated you.
verses.11: And one man caused harm to his wife; another man made his own genitals unclean at that moment. And another man treated his sister, who was his mother’s daughter, with cruelty.
verses.12: May they take you away from me, so that the bloodshed may stop. May they take away what belongs to you. May your enemies be destroyed in that place. And please, forget about me. Oh Lord, I beg you.
verses.13: And behold, I have brought my hands to your feet, those you built, and to your blood, which was shed within you.
verses.14: Behold, I will stand before you if your hands are strong in those days when I create you. I am the LORD who spoke and acted.
verses.15: And I will spread you out throughout the nations, and your descendants will live in various lands. And I will remove your shame from you.
verses.16: And your land will be a place of wonder to other nations, and you will know that I am Jehovah.
verses.17: And the word of Jehovah came to me, saying:
verses.18: In those days, I had a house in Israel. All its furnishings were made of gold, copper, and brass.
verses.19: Therefore, thus said Adonai YHWH: Since you all belong to Him, I will bring you back into the midst of Jerusalem.
verses.20: I will take away gold, silver, copper, brass, and other metals, and I will put them into the fire that burns upon it. Thus, I will burn you with my flames, and I will destroy you completely.
verses.21: And I will enter among you, and I will burn you with fire. You will be destroyed completely.
verses.22: In the midst of gold, in the midst of a treasury, so too will you be filled with it. And know that I, Jehovah, have poured out my fire upon you.
verses.23: And the word of Jehovah came to me, saying:
verses.24: Man said to her, “This is a land that is not pure. It has not been purified on the day of wrath.”
verses.25: Her prophets were trapped inside her; they were like birds that were being devoured. They ate each other. She became too full of them.
verses.26: Their priests have profaned my laws. They have defiled my holy things between those that are holy and those that are unholy. They did not distinguish between the holy and the unholy. They also desecrated my sacred places with their actions. May they be punished in their own homes.
verses.27: Her legs are like those of a vulture, ready to devour its prey. It spits out blood, thereby destroying lives in its pursuit of its food.
verses.28: And their prophets told them dreams and performed miracles for them. They said, “Thus says the Lord Jehovah.” But Jehovah did not speak in that manner.
verses.29: The people of the land were oppressed and stolen from by others. They were poor and destitute. The foreigners also oppressed them, without any justice being done.
verses.30: And I seek among them a man who is strong and brave, who can stand before me on the battlefield, so that I won’t be defeated. But I couldn’t find such a person.
verses.31: And I will pour out my wrath on them in fire. May their paths be destroyed. I will say, “O Lord Yahweh!”
